title: sesleria × tuzsonii
intro: Sesleria × tuzsonii, commonly known as Tuzson's fescue or mountain fescue, is a hybrid ornamental grass belonging to the family Poaceae. This plant is valued for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving respiratory health. The therapeutic actions of Sesleria × tuzsonii include its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which can help to soothe and calm the mind and body. Bioactive constituents of Sesleria × tuzsonii include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
